truthMethod: Manual reading of pinned source before running either query against the product. These tasks were first evaluated after freezing the numeric-context-followup prototype, independently of the Django development task. Subsequent runs are regression validation, not unseen evaluation. The header task covers the default client error path, assuming a writable socket and no custom client error handler. The body task covers the built-in buffered body parser, with both advertised and observed length enforcement. Dynamic dispatch and external createError implementation are not assumed exact. File judgments are incomplete; no product output was used to define or revise this truth.
